purpose: Close body-level confidence for exact actor-template records using the compact initializer contract and paired VM decoders, without claiming live producers or consumers.

initializer.contract: Actor_InitializeFromTemplate copies the compact template fields and initializes the selected actor state from each 20-byte source record.

evidence: Each record occupies exactly one 20-byte actor-template source record between canonical neighboring templates.
The compact initializer contract identifies the runtime type, movement/animation pointers, resource count, and trailing flags without relying on a guessed higher-level role.
The Type-0x7C and Type-0x84 0x0F22 records point to independently decoded VM streams with exact non-overlapping extents.
limitations: No static producer, active dispatch-table entry, or runtime consumer is recovered for these specific records.
The neutral UNREFERENCED names are retained where no subsystem identity is established.
